description: A 3D oscilloscope that plots the path of a vector arriving from the module on its left, and passes that vector on to the module on its right

params.text: Adds a Tin to the left, which feeds any three voltages in for graphing
Adds a Tout to the right, which brings the graphed vector out to ports

notes: hovering over the display brings up its controls: chevrons at each edge spin the plot, XYZ shows or hides the axes, 123 shows or hides the voltages as numbers, plus and minus zoom
the house button in the corner of the display resets the orientation and zoom, and the empty brackets clear the plotted path
dragging in the middle of the display reorients it and stops any automatic rotation, which a chevron restarts
the display stays blank until a vector arrives from the left: Frolic, Glee, Lark, Zoo, Tin, Pivot, Rotini, Split/Add/Merge, Nucleus, Polynucleus, Elastika or another Tricorder.
menu: Rotation speed — sets automatic rotation anywhere from 0.01RPM to 100RPM, with 1RPM as the default
Insert Tricorder on right — adds a Tricorder to the right, which plots the outgoing vector in 3D
